course.title: Science 12th (PCMB) - NIRBHAY
course.description:
NIRBHAY Batch – Class 12th Science (Boards 2026)

Fearless. Powerful. Complete Crash + Revision Batch.

  1. Complete coverage of Class 12 Science: Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology. 
  2. Live interactive classes (2 hours): Concepts + Numericals + Board-focused questions.
  3. 24×7 class recordings available on the Next Toppers App/Website.
  4. School-timing friendly schedule for stress-free study.
  5. Two live classes every day (2 hours each). Final timings shared in the Orientation Session
  6. Doubt-solving session after every chapter.
  7. Weekly study timetable provided for proper planning.
  8. PDF notes after every class (chapter-wise) on the App/Website.
  9. English, Hindi (Core) available in recorded form.
  10. Class starts from 1st December 2025 and complete revision finished by mid-January. 
  11. The entire course will remain accessible to you until your board exams in 2026.
